what_it_is: Owns the 500 largest US companies in proportion to their stock market value.
notes: Series name in filing: VANGUARD 500 INDEX FUND (registrant Vanguard Index Funds). Largest S&P 500 fund by assets with a clean N-PORT. SPY (SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust) IVV (iShares Core S&P 500) and FXAIX (Fidelity 500 Index) track the same index so their AI share is essentially the same.

what_it_is: Owns almost every US-listed company from the largest to the smallest.
notes: Series name in filing: VANGUARD TOTAL STOCK MARKET INDEX FUND. Same series as VTI and VTSAX (different share classes). Also the main stock holding inside Vanguard target-date funds.

what_it_is: Owns the 100 largest non-financial companies on the Nasdaq exchange; heavy in technology.
notes: Series name in filing: Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1.

what_it_is: Owns the same 500 companies as the S&P 500 but about the same dollar amount of each one.
notes: Series name in filing: Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF (registrant Invesco Exchange-Traded Fund Trust). Included as a contrast to the market-value-weighted S&P 500 fund. Reports securities-lending cash collateral so weights sum above 100%.

what_it_is: Owns stocks from the US and from other countries around the world in proportion to market value.
notes: Series name in filing: VANGUARD TOTAL WORLD STOCK INDEX FUND (registrant Vanguard International Equity Index Funds).

what_it_is: Owns only technology companies from the US stock market.
notes: Series name in filing: VANGUARD INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY INDEX FUND (registrant Vanguard Specialized Funds). XLK (Technology Select Sector SPDR) is the main alternative and was read only for the identifier check.

what_it_is: Owns about 25 of the biggest chip designers and chip equipment makers.
notes: Series name in filing: VanEck Semiconductor ETF (registrant VanEck ETF Trust). SOXX (iShares Semiconductor ETF) is the main alternative.

what_it_is: A one-ticket fund for people retiring around 2060: mostly stock funds that shift toward bonds over time.
notes: Series name in filing: VANGUARD TARGET RETIREMENT 2060 FUND (registrant Vanguard Chester Funds). Owns four other Vanguard funds; US and international stock funds are looked through to stock level.

what_it_is: A one-ticket fund for people retiring around 2030: a mix of stock funds and bond funds.
notes: Series name in filing: VANGUARD TARGET RETIREMENT 2030 FUND (registrant Vanguard Chester Funds). Same look-through method as the 2060 fund; bond funds are recorded as bonds and not opened.
